title: Stop tool hopping.
summary:
How to start with AI as a beginner: pick one tool and use it every day for a month.
Stop tool hopping. Pick ONE tool (Claude or ChatGPT, I don't mind which), list the tasks you hate doing and hand the repeatable ones to AI, then give it context: talk to it like a colleague and show it examples of what you want. Do that for a month and AI gets a lot easier than you thought.
I'm Manraj Sidhu, AI developer, and this is what I tell every friend who asks how to start.
Works with @claudeai or @openai.
Comment START and I'll send you my starter prompt template. Follow @manrajtalks
